floater.name: sl_speaker_setup
floater.title: Set Up As Speaker
floater.floater.string: No object (select one prim you can modify)
This prim is not a speaker yet. The defaults are shown.
This prim has other hover text: setting the tag replaces it.
This prim is a speaker: its current tag is shown.
This prim is a speaker; parts of its tag were not understood:
This prim already carries exactly this tag.
Putting the setup script into the prim...
does not read back as set
Can't tell yet whether this object qualifies.
This object stands on another parcel than you: can't tell from here whether it qualifies.
This object qualifies: its owner or group matches this parcel.
This object does not qualify yet: set its group to the parcel's group, deed it, or have the parcel owner own it.
Scripts may not run here for this object (no-script parcel), so the setup script could stay stopped in it.

line_editor.name: group
line_editor.tool_tip: Speaker group: 1 to 24 of a-z 0-9 _ . - (default main). Groups can have different levels and ranges, for example a stage and a quieter bar; all play the same parcel stream.

combo_box.name: channel
combo_box.tool_tip: What this speaker plays: mono (left and right mixed), the left or the right channel (place one of each for a stereo stage), or sub (low-passed mono).

slider.label: Volume:
slider.name: volume
slider.tool_tip: Speaker level, 0 to 2 (1 = the stream as is, 2 = +6 dB), times each listener's music volume.

slider.label: Range (m):
slider.name: range
slider.tool_tip: How far the speaker is heard, 5 to 100 metres.

check_box.label: Directional, cone of
check_box.name: use_dir
check_box.tool_tip: Play in a cone around the prim's +X axis (for PA boxes) instead of all round.

spinner.name: dir
spinner.tool_tip: Full cone angle in degrees, 1 to 360, around the prim's +X axis. 360 is all round.

check_box.label: Off (keep the tag, silence this speaker)
check_box.name: off

floater.text: Speakers play for others only if owned by the parcel owner, or set to or deeded to the parcel's group.

button.label: Set speaker tag
button.name: apply
button.tool_tip: Put a small script into this prim that sets the tag as faint hover text (Slipstream does not draw it) and then deletes itself. No script keeps running.

button.label: Remove speaker tag
button.name: remove
button.tool_tip: Put a small script into this prim that clears its hover text and then deletes itself.
